name: Silver Breeze - Inspired by Creed Silver Mountain Water | Fresh Unisex Perfume
description: Silver Breeze, inspired by the iconic Creed Silver Mountain Water, is a masterpiece that brings the purity of crisp mountain air to life. This luxurious fragrance opens with a burst of zesty bergamot and juicy mandarin, creating an energetic and refreshing start. The heart reveals green tea and blackcurrant, blending into a calming and uplifting aroma. Finally, the base of musk, sandalwood, and petitgrain delivers a smooth and elegant finish. Crafted with a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, Silver Breeze ensures long-lasting freshness and a scent that evolves beautifully throughout the day. Perfect for both men and women, this unisex fragrance is ideal for any occasion, from casual outings to elegant evenings. Features Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin Heart Notes: Green Tea, Blackcurrant Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Petitgrain Longevity: 8-10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Suitable for daily wear, outdoor events, and special occasions Why Choose Silver Breeze? Inspired by the luxurious Creed Silver Mountain Water A unisex fragrance with a fresh, invigorating profile 40-50% perfume oil concentration for enhanced longevity and projection Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir, offering premium quality at an affordable price Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume with high-quality natural oils Care: Keep in a cool, dry place to maintain the fragrance’s purity Packaging: Presented in a sleek, travel-friendly glass bottle
